electrode_placement: torso (Mason-Likar) for both recordings, unchanged between them
units: digital units; divide by adc_gain_per_mV for millivolts (one unit = 0.763 uV)
time_reference: relative only (seconds within each strip, milliseconds from each beat fiducial); no wall-clock time is included

strips.filtering: none; the figure applies a 0.5-100 Hz display band-pass
strips.layout: pad_samples of padding, window_samples shown, pad_samples of padding

beats.encoding: value = counts + offset[:, None, :] (int16 + int32 per-beat, per-lead offset)
beats.note: the analysis beat arrays are aligned to sub-sample fiducials (interpolated); they are published rounded to the device's digital unit (<= 0.38 uV error)

run.inclusion: beats excluded from the average for noise / morphology QC are marked run_included = False

analysis.spatial_velocity: 3rd-order Butterworth 100 Hz low-pass of the mean beat; leads I, II, V1-V6
analysis.run_qrs_offset_override_reason: the S upstroke bends gradually into the upsloping ST segment; the threshold marks the start of the bend (set by eye on review)
analysis.voltage_reference: mean of the samples 10 ms to 0.5 ms before the global QRS onset
